newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Explorers Index falls 0.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Australian Explorers Index falls 0.75 pct.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index edged down 0.75 percent in the week to Friday. The All Ordinaries Index rose 0.47 percent. Changes, in percent:
Apr 11 Apr 4 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The Eyres Reed Explorer Index continued its slump, easing 24.7 points in the week. Falls outnumbered gains 2 to 1.

Best performers included Acclaim Exploration NL up 0.9 cents to 6.1 cents after an exciting preliminary gold intersection from its Barrambie, WA exploration. Menzies Gold NL up six cents to 56 cents, Pacrim Energy NL up 1.5 cents to 12.5 cents and Leo Shield Exploration NL up eight cents to 73 cents.
Falls included Indonesian gold hopeful Lone Star Exploration NL down seven cents to 41 cents, Precious Metals Australia Ltd off six cents to 25 cents.

Offshore diamond explorers fell after Cambridge Gulf Exploration's drilling vessel was sent back to Singapore following further mechanical breakdowns. Cambridge's share price fell 6.5 cents to 30 cents, Australian Kimberley Diamonds off 1.9 cents to 8.1 cents and Zephyr Minerals dropped 1.9 cents to eight cents.
